headline: For prime q, two-qudit CZ_q has fundamental multiplicities m0=2q-1 and ma=q-1; adjoint sl(q^2) grades (q+1)(q^2-1) and q(q^2-1); W(3,q) point orbits 1^(q+1) q^(q(q+1)); and nonzero-Pauli-vector orbits 1^(q^2-1) q^(q(q^2-1)). Hence the nontrivial projective orbit count is k=q(q+1), while the nontrivial vector orbit count equals every charged adjoint-grade dimension and |SL(2,q)|.
scope: Exact finite theorem for prime q; no Standard-Model interpretation is asserted away from q=3.
